description_en: Queries the user authorization agreement for urgent vulnerabilities
description_zh: 查询应急漏洞用户授权协议
name: DescribeEmgUserAgreement

parameters.help_en: The ID of the member accounts in the resource directory folder (Alibaba Cloud account). You can invoke the [DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
资源目录成员账号ID（阿里云账号）。
调用[DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: resource_directory_account_id

Auth.description_en:
Indicates whether authorization for urgent vulnerability scanning is granted. Valid values:

true: Authorized.
false: Unauthorized
Auth.description_zh:
应急漏洞扫描是否授权。取值：

true：已获得授权
false：未获得授权
